title: Build and maintain overview index for OVER/XOVER
description:
Implement the overview index: on article ingestion, extract and store the RFC 3977 overview fields (Subject, From, Date, Message-ID, References, :bytes, :lines) in SQLite keyed by (group, article_number). Implement query_overview(group: &str, range: ArticleRange) -> Vec<OverviewRecord>. Artifact: reader/src/store/overview.rs.

Acceptance:
- Overview populated at ingestion time (not lazily)
- query_overview returns records in article-number order
- Missing articles in range are skipped (no error)
- All 7 RFC 3977 required overview fields present in every record
- Unit test: insert 50 articles, query ranges, verify correctness
